parole.significato: A viral fever caused by the Chikungunya virus, an alphavirus spread by mosquito bites.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Makonde chikungunya (“that which bends up”), apparently referring to the arthritic effects of the disease. See -kunja, a suffix related to bending. Compare Swahili kunja (“to bend, to fold”).

parole.significato: A people of southeast Tanzania and northern Mozambique.
parole.testo: From Chimakonde or Makonde, the Makonde name of the language.
